MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
RE: COUNTY OF SAN DIEGO Application for Federal Assistance under the Community Development Block Grant Program, U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 1977, for purposes of conducting a Residential Rehabilitation Loan Program.
Affected Agencies: County of San Diego; California State Historic Preservation Office
The purpose of this Memorandum of Understanding is to document and clarify the responsibilities and obligations of the Affected Agencies with regard to the County's application for federal assistance under the Community Development Block Grant Program of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, for purposes of conducting a Residential Rehabilitation Loan Program. The terms of this Memorandum represent neither an exception to nor a departure from the responsibilities which all Community Block Grant applicants are required to assume under the terms of the authorities listed below.
The signatories agree to abide by the terms of this Memorandum and shall discharge in good faith, their respective obligations and responsibilities as noted below:
The County of San Diego shall:
Recognize and comply with the provisions of the following authorities in conducting or contracting to have conducted a Residential Rehabilitation Loan Program:
a. The National Historic Preservation Act of 1966 as amended;
b. 36 CFR 800;
c. 36 CFR 63; in connection with contemplated zone changes; redevelopment projects, housing rehabilitation; housing rehabilitation loans; economic development programs; and cultural resource surveys, related to the Residential Rehabilitation Loan Program.
The staff to the State Historic Preservation Officer shall:
Recognize and implement its responsibilities under the authorities listed above and shall cooperate to the fullest extent with the County of San Diego to ensure compliance with the designated authorities.
